This year I am lucky because I received a FISP coupon, so I will use the small bag of NPK at planting and urea for top-dressing on my maize plot. The plot is very small, only a bit more than a tenth of a hectare, so the subsidized bags will be enough if I apply them carefully. I also put kraal manure from my goats on the plot before the rains, and I am intercropping with pigeon pea like my neighbors do here in Machinga. I cannot afford pesticides or to hire people — my husband and I will do the weeding ourselves, and the children help on weekends.
